models.description: Pancreatic lesion, pancreas head/body/tail/duct and 24 surrounding abdominal structures on CT. nnU-Net v2 ResEnc-M, region-based (sigmoid) heads, trained on the PanTS dataset (9,000 CTs); the nnU-Net baseline on the PanTS leaderboard.
